title: Corpus precision via exhaustive scopes
description: Compute real precision on benchmark corpus repos by declaring exhaustive file scopes in annotations. Extra scanner hits in those files are false positives without a per-repo negative.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Extra data_item fill from existing packet includes is on dataparade-cli main (ff6cfd4). Canonical accepted positives: components 519, data_flows 419, pii_signals 325, data_items 302.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Corpus evals after dataparade-cli main ff6cfd4 (accepted gold: 519/419/325/302).

Jest fixtures: scanner tests/eval 6 suites / 14 tests pass; CLI tests/eval 3 suites / 3 tests pass.

Corpus `pnpm exec ts-node --transpile-only tests/benchmark/run-benchmark.ts` (29 packets, 1717 accepted cases): 984 unread (57%) — PHP/Ruby/Swift/Rust evidence the CLI scanner did not ingest (wordpress, magento, discourse, redmine, spree, drupal, vapor, hyperswitch). Scored packets with ingest: keycloak recall 22.2% / prec 12.5%; medusa-customer 25.0% / 63.6%; easy-school 17.4% / 30.8%; saleor 15.6% / 11.1%; gitea 16.7% / 18.2%; most others 0–9% recall. `pnpm run benchmark:run` itself fails tsc (`.ts` import extensions).

Plexus `evaluate accuracy` / Cucumber GraphQL path did not complete: Virtuus proxy fails startup (`PLEXUS_PROXY_AUTH_MODE=trusted_open requires PLEXUS_BACKEND_MODE=local`). scan-findings cucumber scenarios that do not start GraphQL passed.
